task: CLI에 폴더 단위 변환을 넣어줘. `anydoc ./inbox -o ./out` 하면 폴더 안 문서를 전부 markdown으로 바꾸는 식으로.
hidden_context: The user runs anydoc in a contract-review product. This command will run as a nightly batch over customer uploads.
About 200,000 files per night, mostly docx, pdf and xlsx; a few xlsx are up to 300 MB. The run must finish inside a 3-hour window.
It runs as a Kubernetes Job: 8 vCPU, 4 GiB memory limit; the container is killed above that.
About 2% of files are corrupt, encrypted or unsupported. The run must continue past them, and the next pipeline step reads a machine-readable list of failed files to requeue them.
The inbox is nested: inbox/<customer-id>/<yyyy-mm>/<file>. The same file name appears under different customers.
The Job is restarted after a crash and must not reconvert files it already converted.
The documents are confidential customer contracts and must never be sent to an external service.
Next quarter the same batch will be called from a Python pipeline (Airflow) instead of the CLI.
